question_en: Which statements are true? 1) In an isothermal process all the heat supplied is converted into work. 2) In an isochoric process the gas does work. 3) A gas cools down in adiabatic expansion. 4) Heat flows by itself from a cold body to a hot one.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Izotermik jarayonda berilgan issiqlik to'liq ishga aylanadi. 2) Izoxorik jarayonda gaz ish bajaradi. 3) Adiabatik kengayishda gaz soviydi. 4) Issiqlik o'z-o'zidan sovuq jismdan issiq jismga o'tadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) В изотермическом процессе вся сообщённая теплота превращается в работу. 2) В изохорном процессе газ совершает работу. 3) При адиабатном расширении газ охлаждается. 4) Теплота сама переходит от холодного тела к горячему.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 va 3 to'g'ri; izoxorik jarayonda A = 0, issiqlik o'z-o'zidan faqat issiqdan sovuqqa o'tadi.
Asos: birinchi va ikkinchi qonunlar.

distractors.A: 2-fikr noto'g'ri: izoxorik jarayonda ish nolga teng
distractors.D: 4-fikr noto'g'ri: issiqlik o'z-o'zidan issiqdan sovuqqa o'tadi

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 2 неверно: в изохорном процессе работа равна нулю
distractors_ru.D: утверждение 4 неверно: теплота сама идёт от горячего к холодному

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is false: in an isochoric process the work is zero
distractors_en.D: statement 4 is false: heat flows by itself from hot to cold

question_en: In what form is the first law of thermodynamics written for an adiabatic process?
question_uz: Adiabatik jarayon uchun termodinamikaning birinchi qonuni qaysi ko'rinishda yoziladi?
question_ru: В каком виде записывается первый закон термодинамики для адиабатного процесса?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Adiabatik jarayonda Q = 0, shuning uchun 0 = ΔU + A, ya'ni A = −ΔU.
Asos: Q = ΔU + A, Q = 0.

distractors_en.A: Q = ΔU is the isochoric process (A = 0)
distractors_en.B: Q = A is the isothermal process (ΔU = 0)

question_en: When a gas receives $1.4\ \mathrm{kJ}$ of heat, its internal energy increases by $0.9\ \mathrm{kJ}$. How much work does the gas do ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_uz: Gazga $1.4\ \mathrm{kJ}$ issiqlik berilganda uning ichki energiyasi $0.9\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ga ortdi. Gaz qanday ish bajardi ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_ru: Когда газу сообщили $1.4\ \mathrm{kJ}$ теплоты, его внутренняя энергия увеличилась на $0.9\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Какую работу совершил газ ($\mathrm{J}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. A = Q − ΔU = 1400 − 900 = 500 J.
Asos: termodinamikaning birinchi qonuni Q = ΔU + A.

distractors.C: bu ichki energiya o'zgarishi, ish emas

distractors_ru.C: это изменение внутренней энергии, а не работа
distractors_ru.D: это сообщённая теплота, а не работа

distractors_en.C: this is the change in internal energy, not the work
distractors_en.D: this is the heat supplied, not the work
distractors_en.E: the subtraction was done in the reverse order

question_en: $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ of a monatomic gas in a cylinder receives $747.9\ \mathrm{J}$ of heat. By how many kelvins does the temperature of the gas rise? $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$.
question_uz: Ballondagi $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ bir atomli gazga $747.9\ \mathrm{J}$ issiqlik berildi. Gaz temperaturasi necha kelvinga ortdi? $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$.
question_ru: $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ одноатомного газа в баллоне сообщили $747.9\ \mathrm{J}$ теплоты. На сколько кельвинов выросла температура газа? $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Ballon — izoxorik: Q = (3/2)νRΔT, ΔT = 2Q/(3νR) = 30 K.
Asos: izoxorik jarayonda Q = ΔU.

distractors_en.A: the factor 3/2 was lost: Q = νRΔT
distractors_en.B: the isobaric formula Q = (5/2)νRΔT was used
distractors_en.C: the amount of substance was ignored
distractors_en.E: the temperature does change in an isochoric process

question_en: A monatomic ideal gas receives $1500\ \mathrm{J}$ of heat isobarically. How much work does the gas do ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_uz: Bir atomli ideal gazga izobarik ravishda $1500\ \mathrm{J}$ issiqlik berildi. Gaz qanday ish bajardi ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_ru: Одноатомному идеальному газу изобарно сообщили $1500\ \mathrm{J}$ теплоты. Какую работу совершил газ ($\mathrm{J}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Izobarik jarayonda Q : ΔU : A = 5 : 3 : 2, A = (2/5)Q = 600 J.
Asos: Q = (5/2)pΔV, A = pΔV.

distractors_ru.A: Q = A только в изотермическом процессе
distractors_ru.D: при изобарном расширении газ совершает работу

distractors_en.A: Q = A holds only in an isothermal process
distractors_en.B: this is the change in internal energy (3/5)Q
distractors_en.D: the gas does work in isobaric expansion

question_en: When a gas is compressed adiabatically, external forces do $2\ \mathrm{kJ}$ of work. By how much does the internal energy of the gas change ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
question_uz: Gaz adiabatik siqilganda tashqi kuchlar $2\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ish bajardi. Gazning ichki energiyasi qanchaga o'zgardi ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
question_ru: При адиабатном сжатии газа внешние силы совершили работу $2\ \mathrm{kJ}$. На сколько изменилась внутренняя энергия газа ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Q = 0, ΔU = A′ = +2 kJ — gaz isiydi.
Asos: adiabatik jarayonda ΔU = A′.

distractors.A: ishora xato: siqishda ichki energiya ortadi

distractors_ru.A: ошибка в знаке: при сжатии внутренняя энергия растёт

distractors_en.A: sign error: compression increases the internal energy
distractors_en.E: the work was divided by two

question_en: In one cycle a heat engine takes $5\ \mathrm{kJ}$ of heat from the heater and gives $3.5\ \mathrm{kJ}$ to the cooler. Find the efficiency of the engine.
question_uz: Issiqlik dvigateli bir siklda isitkichdan $5\ \mathrm{kJ}$ issiqlik olib, sovitkichga $3.5\ \mathrm{kJ}$ beradi. Dvigatelning FIK ini toping.
question_ru: Тепловой двигатель за цикл получает от нагревателя $5\ \mathrm{kJ}$ теплоты и отдаёт холодильнику $3.5\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Найдите КПД двигателя.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. η = (Q₁ − Q₂)/Q₁ = 1.5/5 = 0.3, ya'ni 30 foiz.
Asos: FIK η = A/Q₁.

distractors.B: Q₁/Q₂ olingan — FIK birdan katta bo'lolmaydi

distractors_ru.B: взято Q₁/Q₂ — КПД не может быть больше единицы
distractors_ru.E: это работа (в kJ), а не КПД

distractors_en.B: Q₁/Q₂ was taken; the efficiency cannot exceed one
distractors_en.D: the work was divided by Q₂
distractors_en.E: this is the work (in kJ), not the efficiency

question_en: The heater of an ideal heat engine is at $227\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and the cooler at $27\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Find the efficiency of the engine.
question_uz: Ideal issiqlik mashinasi isitkichining temperaturasi $227\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, sovitkichniki $27\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Mashinaning FIK ini toping.
question_ru: Температура нагревателя идеальной тепловой машины $227\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, холодильника $27\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Найдите КПД машины.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. T₁ = 500 K, T₂ = 300 K: η = (500 − 300)/500 = 0.4.
Asos: Karno formulasi, temperaturalar kelvinda.

distractors_en.B: the temperatures were used in degrees Celsius
distractors_en.D: T₂/T₁ in degrees Celsius was taken
distractors_en.E: the difference was divided by T₂

question_en: The absolute temperature of the heater of an ideal heat engine is $3$ times that of the cooler. How much work does the engine do if it takes $60\ \mathrm{kJ}$ of heat from the heater ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
question_uz: Ideal issiqlik mashinasi isitkichining absolyut temperaturasi sovitkichnikidan $3$ marta katta. Mashina isitkichdan $60\ \mathrm{kJ}$ issiqlik olsa, qancha ish bajaradi ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
question_ru: Абсолютная температура нагревателя идеальной тепловой машины в $3$ раза больше, чем холодильника. Какую работу совершит машина, получив от нагревателя $60\ \mathrm{kJ}$ теплоты ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. η = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3, A = ηQ₁ = 40 kJ.
Asos: Karno formulasi va A = ηQ₁.

distractors_en.A: this is the heat Q₂ given to the cooler

question_en: A heat engine with an efficiency of $25$ percent gives $900\ \mathrm{J}$ of heat to the cooler per cycle. How much work does the engine do per cycle ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_uz: FIK i $25$ foiz bo'lgan issiqlik mashinasi bir siklda sovitkichga $900\ \mathrm{J}$ issiqlik beradi. Mashina bir siklda qanday ish bajaradi ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_ru: Тепловая машина с КПД $25$ процентов отдаёт холодильнику за цикл $900\ \mathrm{J}$ теплоты. Какую работу совершает машина за цикл ($\mathrm{J}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Q₂ = (1 − η)Q₁: Q₁ = 900/0.75 = 1200 J, A = Q₁ − Q₂ = 300 J.
Asos: η = A/Q₁, Q₁ = A + Q₂.

distractors_en.A: the efficiency was multiplied by Q₂
distractors_en.B: this is the heat Q₁ from the heater
distractors_en.D: Q₂ was divided by the efficiency

question_en: The figure shows a cycle $1\to2\to3\to4\to1$ of a monatomic ideal gas. On which parts of the cycle does the gas receive heat?
question_uz: Rasmda bir atomli ideal gaz bajaradigan $1\to2\to3\to4\to1$ sikl ko'rsatilgan. Siklning qaysi qismlarida gaz issiqlik oladi?
question_ru: На рисунке показан цикл $1\to2\to3\to4\to1$ одноатомного идеального газа. На каких участках цикла газ получает теплоту?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1→2: V const, p ortadi — T ortadi, Q > 0; 2→3: izobarik kengayish, Q > 0; 3→4 va 4→1 da gaz issiqlik beradi.
Asos: Q = ΔU + A.

distractors.A: 1→2 da ham issiqlik olinadi: izoxorik isish
distractors.E: 2→3 da ham issiqlik olinadi: izobarik kengayish

distractors_ru.A: на 1→2 тоже получает теплоту: изохорное нагревание
distractors_ru.C: на этих участках газ отдаёт теплоту
distractors_ru.E: на 2→3 тоже получает теплоту: изобарное расширение

distractors_en.A: heat is also received on 1→2: isochoric heating
distractors_en.C: on these parts the gas gives off heat
distractors_en.D: on 3→4 T falls, so heat is given off
distractors_en.E: heat is also received on 2→3: isobaric expansion

question_en: The heater of an ideal engine is at $500\ \mathrm{K}$ and the cooler at $300\ \mathrm{K}$. By how much does the efficiency increase if the heater temperature is raised to $750\ \mathrm{K}$?
question_uz: Ideal mashina isitkichining temperaturasi $500\ \mathrm{K}$, sovitkichniki $300\ \mathrm{K}$. Isitkich temperaturasi $750\ \mathrm{K}$ gacha oshirilsa, FIK qanchaga ortadi?
question_ru: Температура нагревателя идеальной машины $500\ \mathrm{K}$, холодильника $300\ \mathrm{K}$. На сколько возрастёт КПД, если температуру нагревателя поднять до $750\ \mathrm{K}$?

distractors_ru.D: это новый КПД, а не прирост
distractors_ru.E: КПД зависит и от температуры нагревателя

distractors_en.B: this is the relative rise of the heater temperature
distractors_en.D: this is the new efficiency, not the increase
distractors_en.E: the efficiency also depends on the heater temperature

question_en: A monatomic ideal gas at $80\ \mathrm{kPa}$ expands isobarically, and its volume increases by $5\ \mathrm{L}$. How much heat was given to the gas ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_uz: $80\ \mathrm{kPa}$ bosimdagi bir atomli ideal gaz izobarik kengayib, hajmi $5\ \mathrm{L}$ ga ortdi. Gazga qancha issiqlik berilgan ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_ru: Одноатомный идеальный газ при давлении $80\ \mathrm{kPa}$ изобарно расширился, его объём увеличился на $5\ \mathrm{L}$. Какое количество теплоты сообщили газу ($\mathrm{J}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. pΔV = 80000 · 0.005 = 400 J, Q = (5/2)pΔV = 1000 J.
Asos: izobarik jarayonda Q = (5/2)pΔV.

distractors.E: bosim kPa da, hajm m³ da qo'yilgan

distractors_ru.B: это работа газа, а не теплота
distractors_ru.E: давление в kPa, объём в m³

distractors_en.B: this is the work of the gas, not the heat
distractors_en.C: this is the change in internal energy
distractors_en.E: the pressure was used in kPa with the volume in m³

question_en: The figure shows the graphs of four processes of an ideal gas starting from state $A$: an isobar, an isotherm, an adiabat and an isochore. Which graph is the adiabat?
question_uz: Rasmda ideal gazning $A$ holatidan chiqadigan to'rtta jarayon grafigi ko'rsatilgan: izobara, izoterma, adiabata va izoxora. Qaysi grafik adiabata?
question_ru: На рисунке показаны графики четырёх процессов идеального газа из состояния $A$: изобара, изотерма, адиабата и изохора. Какой график — адиабата?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Adiabata izotermadan tikroq pasayadi: kengayishda bosim V ortgani va T pasaygani uchun kamayadi.
Asos: pVᵞ = const, γ > 1.

uz: 2 va 3 — egri chiziqlar, adiabata tikroq: $$pV=\mathrm{const},\qquad pV^{\gamma}=\mathrm{const},\ \gamma=\frac{5}{3}$$
en: 2 and 3 are curves; the adiabat is steeper: $$pV=\mathrm{const},\qquad pV^{\gamma}=\mathrm{const},\ \gamma=\frac{5}{3}$$

distractors_en.B: 2 is the isotherm: it is less steep than the adiabat
distractors_en.E: there is only one adiabat: 2 is the isotherm

question_en: The heater of an ideal heat engine is at $400\ \mathrm{K}$ and the cooler at $300\ \mathrm{K}$. The engine does $500\ \mathrm{J}$ of work per cycle. How much heat does it give to the cooler per cycle ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_uz: Ideal issiqlik mashinasi isitkichining temperaturasi $400\ \mathrm{K}$, sovitkichniki $300\ \mathrm{K}$. Mashina bir siklda $500\ \mathrm{J}$ ish bajaradi. U bir siklda sovitkichga qancha issiqlik beradi ($\mathrm{J}$)?
question_ru: Температура нагревателя идеальной тепловой машины $400\ \mathrm{K}$, холодильника $300\ \mathrm{K}$. За цикл машина совершает работу $500\ \mathrm{J}$. Сколько теплоты она отдаёт холодильнику за цикл ($\mathrm{J}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. η = 0.25, Q₁ = A/η = 2000 J, Q₂ = Q₁ − A = 1500 J.
Asos: Karno formulasi, Q₁ = A + Q₂.

en: From the heater and to the cooler: $$Q_1=\frac{A}{\eta}=2000\ \mathrm{J},\qquad Q_2=Q_1-A=1500\ \mathrm{J}$$

distractors_en.A: the work was multiplied by (1 − η)
distractors_en.B: this is the heat Q₁ from the heater
distractors_en.C: the work was divided by (1 − η)
distractors_en.D: the work was multiplied by the efficiency
